featured_reviews.name: Ravina Negi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Tansih Textile (Bhuleshwar branch) to buy a lehenga for my sister’s wedding, and the experience was honestly wonderful.

Wedding shopping can be stressful, especially when you want everything to be perfect. But the moment we entered the store, we felt comfortable. The staff was polite, patient, and really helpful. They didn’t rush us at all, even though we took our time looking through multiple designs. They understood that it was for my sister’s big day and helped us pick something that truly stood out.

The collection was beautiful — from traditional bridal lehengas to more modern and trendy designs. We found a stunning lehenga with intricate embroidery and rich fabric that looked even better in person than we imagined. The detailing and finishing were impressive, and the quality felt premium.

What I appreciated most was their honest suggestions. They guided us on color combinations, dupatta styling, and even minor alterations to make it fit perfectly. The final look was absolutely gorgeous, and my sister received so many compliments at the wedding.

Overall, shopping at Tansih Textile, Bhuleshwar branch was a memorable and satisfying experience. If you’re looking for elegant wedding outfits with good service and a wide variety, I would definitely recommend checking them out.

featured_reviews.name: Apurva More
featured_reviews.review_text:
2 stars is for the beautiful collection but I was disappointed with the service and especially the fitting of the dress they did.
I bought the outfit a week ago (Saturday) and clearly confirmed twice if it would be altered by the next Saturday. After confirming I made an advance payment. Instead of the next Saturday, I went to the store to collect my outfit on Sunday and it was still not ready. I was slightly pissed because I was unwell and traveled from suburbs to town only to return empty handed. They assured they would get it altered and delivered the next day which they did and I wouldn’t have written this review.
The reason of my biggest disappointment is the alteration they did. IT IS ABSOLUTELY HORRIBLE and I regret spending 4.5k on this. The dress is beautiful but what’s the use if I am not going to feel beautiful wearing it? Here’s what they do, they have a free size (L) and alter it to your size if you’re smaller. It’s okay if it’s done well but mine is HORRIBLY altered especially on the arms side.
Not sure if it was only my dress that was horribly altered because they were in a hurry to send it or more people have experienced this.
If you’re a size XS or S, do not purchase from here or get the dress altered from your own tailor you are confident about.

Feedback for the store - please start making the dresses in different sizes or atleast get a better alteration master.

featured_reviews.name: Yash Goyal
featured_reviews.review_text:
BEST HEARTED AND BEST DESIGNER AMIT JI YOU TRULY ARE A GEM!

I cannot put into words the effort that Battle Harbour Design Studio has put into planning and executing an outfit for me in a short period of time!

Kudos to the Team , their hospitality, generosity & patience is unmatched all throughout India. The elements on their pieces are perfectly executed & there is no room for any error. Simply put they're PERECT AND CAN BE TRUSTED WITH CLOSED EYES!

featured_reviews.name: parth shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Luxury experience, but lacking in service 🤕

I was excited to shop at this boutique, and the outfits are indeed modern and chic. The boutique itself exudes luxury, but that's where the positives end. The staff's attitude and lack of accountability are a major turn-off.

I had two kurtas altered, and they managed to ruin the leather work on both. When I pointed it out, the staff (rude and loud lady at the front desk) was defensive and blamed me. The owner admitted the leather work peels off easily but refused to take responsibility. What's worse, they charge ₹2500 for alterations and still expect customers to be blamed for their mistakes. I did not end up paying though. But my outfits were ruined.

A big brand should be holistic in their services. Customer is king, but not here, apparently. Pathetic experience, and I'll never be back.

featured_reviews.name: Junaid Samsi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great service by Amit, Arshad and Misba.

They were very patient in listening to our requirements and suggested the best outfit to which we couldn’t refuse.

Looking at our tired faces they even gave us snacks to eat.

We were travelling with an infant and it was such a sweet gesture of them to provide us with their office for feed the infant.

featured_reviews.name: Jainam Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I consider myself fortunate to have discovered the finest traditional studio in Mumbai to procure my outfit. Their vast array of options and customization offerings, tailored to match with my fiace attire, proved invaluable. Amit Bhai and Priyanka, the designers, exerted themselves tremendously to produce the ideal outfit for me. I was astounded when I received my outfit in under a month. I express my highest gratitude for your unwavering hard work and unbridled dedication!

I had an amazing experience with the process of creating my customized outfit. It all started with a sketch created by Priyanka, which was then followed by a sample to help me visualize and understand the design better. Once they confirmed my approval, they began making the entire outfit, and it turned out even better than I had expected. I couldn't be happier with the end result!

In short, they provided top-notch creativity and customer service, all while taking minimal time. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for exceptional service and unique designs.

featured_reviews.name: Rachit Arora
featured_reviews.review_text: Bought my kurta from here, the designers and consultants were impeccable. The service was quick and the quality of delivery as well as finished product was the best I could get. Prices are decent as well

featured_reviews.name: Mukesh Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fabric quality is not good and stitching is also not good at all.
Only hospitality is good.I bought clothes worth four lakhs But after wearing it once it is not fit to be worn again after washing it.

featured_reviews.name: Ruchit Sakaria
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ofcourse this store has good collection of clothes and above satisfactory quality of stitching. But most of all, they handle the customers pretty well. I would like to specially mention "Silky" who is a designer here and has been very very helpful in finding the right pick for me. Not just that, she has quite patiently handled multiple iterations from my side. I remember being late for my trial and forgot to inform them. Still, she has handled it quite patiently. This store, *though it may not look like one* is quite professional in a lot of ways.
Thank you guys!☺️

featured_reviews.name: Viha Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Best Design Studio Everrrrrr!!! Amazing Experience! They have a wide variety of casuals and shirts... The collection is mind blowing.. amazing customer service... truly recommended for any occasion!!
